title: How a Man of God Handles Getting Laid Off
caption:
The email comes on a Tuesday. By lunch you don’t have a job, and by dinner you’re wondering who you even are.

Here’s the truth: you lost a role, not your name. You were a son of God before the offer letter and you still are.

Tell one brother. Keep your mornings. Be useful while you wait. Pray hard, then go knock on doors.

“Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.” Proverbs 16:3

Send this to a brother who just got the email.
